evidence: Home page shows 6 templates in grid, each with title, author (e.g. Sarah Chen), and description text.
Each card shows title, author, description, category badge (e.g. Resume), scenario badge (e.g. Business), usage count (e.g. 1,250 uses), and updated date (e.g. Updated 2024-12-01).
Clicking Use Template on Professional Resume opened a dialog with template title, description, author, usage, and a Fill Template form with 14 fields plus a Preview Result tab.
All 14 fields (name, title, email, phone, summary, company, position, startDate, endDate, responsibilities, degree, school, graduationYear, skills) accepted typed values via fill.
After filling all required fields, Preview Result tab rendered a full resume with all field values substituted (Jane Smith, Software Engineer, Tech Corp, etc.).
Preview rendered H1 'Jane Smith', H2/H3 headings, bold (strong) text, emphasis (italic) 'Jan 2020 - Present', and a separator (---) correctly, with all placeholders replaced by entered values.

Copy to Clipboard button copied full Markdown text to clipboard (verified via navigator.clipboard.readText), button changed to 'Copied!' and a toast 'Copied to clipboard! The generated content has been copied.' appeared.
Markdown template (Professional Resume) rendered proper Markdown formatting (headings, bold, italics, separator) after field substitution.
With Email field cleared (a required field), the 'Preview Result' tab became disabled and could not be clicked (timeout: element is not enabled). Restoring the value re-enables it.
While Email was empty, UI showed 'Required fields missing Please fill in: Email' and Preview Result tab was disabled.

issue: No format validation for declared-format fields
actual: Entering 'notanemail' (not a valid email) into the required Email field did not trigger any error, the Preview Result tab remained enabled, and the invalid text was rendered directly into the generated preview ('notanemail' appears verbatim). No email-format or date-format validation is enforced.

evidence: Typing '# Injected Heading **bold** [link](javascript:alert(1)) --- <script>alert(1)</script>' into the Full Name field triggered inline error 'Special characters like < > { } [ ] \\ | \` are not allowed' and disabled the Preview Result tab, preventing generation with the disallowed characters.

Favorited Professional Resume and Weekly Status Report via favorite toggles; header Favorites count showed 2; toggling Favorites-only filter showed 'Showing 2 of 6 templates' with exactly the 2 favorited items.
While in favorites-only mode, typing 'Weekly' into search narrowed results to 'Showing 1 of 6 templates' showing only Weekly Status Report, with favorites filter still active.

Clicking the favorite toggle in the template preview immediately switched its state to 'on', updated header favorites count from 0 to 1, and reflected 'on' state on the corresponding grid card's favorite toggle - all without reload.

Typing 'res' (3 chars) displayed a suggestions list (Professional Resume, Responsibilities, In Progress, etc.); clicking the 'Professional Resume' suggestion filled the search box with 'Professional Resume' and narrowed results to 'Showing 1 of 6 templates'.

actual: Typing 'resme' (typo for 'resume') produced zero results ('Showing 0 of 6 templates', 'No templates found') and no suggestions were shown, so the intended 'Professional Resume' template was neither returned nor suggested.

issue: Oldest First sort does not sort oldest-first
actual: Category filter (Resume -> 1/6), Scenario filter (Academic -> 1/6), and Alphabetical sort all worked correctly. However, selecting 'Oldest First' produced the exact same order as 'Recently Updated' (Dec 5, Dec 1, Nov 28, Nov 15, Oct 20, Sep 30) - newest-to-oldest instead of oldest-to-newest, so the Oldest First sort option is non-functional/reversed.

evidence: Search text, category filter, scenario filter, favorites toggle, and sort selections all updated the visible grid and result count immediately in the same page without any navigation/reload (URL remained http://localhost:6089/ throughout).

Submitted a Markdown custom template with title 'QA Custom Template', description, author 'QA Tester', category Resume, scenario Business, content with {{name}} placeholder, and one defined field 'name'. Submission succeeded.

After submission, 'QA Custom Template' appeared in the grid (Showing 7 of 7 templates). Clicking its Use Template button opened its fill form with the 'name' field, and filling + previewing worked correctly.

Immediately after clicking Submit Template, the result count updated from 'Showing 6 of 6' to 'Showing 7 of 7 templates' and the new card appeared in the grid, with no page navigation/reload (URL unchanged).

Clicking Submit with all fields blank kept the dialog open and did not add a template (library stayed at 6). Filling title/author/description/content but leaving 0 defined fields also blocked submission (dialog stayed open, count stayed 6). Only after adding a field did submission succeed.

Custom template with content using {{name}} twice and one field 'name' submitted successfully; the generated preview showed both occurrences of {{name}} replaced with 'Alex Johnson' with no unresolved placeholders remaining.

issue: Duplicate field labels are not rejected or disambiguated
actual: Adding a second field with the same label 'name' (identical to an already-added field) was accepted without any warning or disambiguation - both fields appeared in the 'Define Template Fields' list with identical label 'name' and identical placeholder '{{name}}', sharing the same data-semtag id, which would cause ambiguous field addressing.

evidence: After reloading http://localhost:6089/, favorites count remained 2 with Professional Resume and Weekly Status Report still marked as favorited (state 'on'), and the custom 'QA Custom Template' still appeared in the library (Showing 7 of 7 templates).
